sections.text: This bay window let in harsh morning glare and gave the room very little privacy.
Now full-height plantation shutters fill the bay, and the louvres tilt for soft, even light.
Close them for complete privacy in the evening, or fold the panels back to open the view.
Café style shutters on the lower half keep the room bright while screening the street.
Another home transformed by our team in Guildford.
